minutes.title: Product Design and Pricing Meeting
minutes.summary: The meeting discussed the design, pricing, and production costs of a new animal-themed product. They decided to sell it for 25 euros with a profit target of 50 million euros in the first year. Next steps include discussing market range and accessibility.
decisions: The product will sell for 25 euros
Production costs are set at 1250, and profit aim is 50 million euros in the first year.

actions.task: Consider adding a large print button for older users
